premarket.market_expectations: Markets face bearish pressure today with negative overnight cues from US indices and rising dollar strength. Treasury yields climbing alongside oil's surge and rupee weakness contribute to the short bias, though domestic institutional flows remain neutral. The VIX's minor decline offers limited comfort given the broader negative technical setup from yesterday's close near range lows.
